---
title: "AM-GM for two variables"
date: 2026-11-08
categories: [inequalities, easy]
---

::: {#thm-amgm}
## AM-GM
For $a, b \ge 0$, $\dfrac{a+b}{2} \ge \sqrt{ab}$.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Solution
Since $(\sqrt a - \sqrt b)^2 \ge 0$, expanding gives $a + b \ge 2\sqrt{ab}$. $\square$
:::
